subject.title: refactor(qa): share Matrix flows across channel drivers

question: Should the channel-lane matcher and Crabline target-normalization helpers become the canonical QA Lab foundation for the dependent Matrix migration stack?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well tested, but it establishes an automation boundary used by a much larger dependent migration and carries a protected maintainer signal; accepting that ownership boundary requires normal owner judgment.

options.title: Refresh and accept the foundation
options.body: Rebase onto current main, repeat focused exact-head Matrix live and Crabline validation, then land this PR before refreshing the dependent stack.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Keep this PR and its dependent work open while owners choose a different lane or target-normalization boundary.

recommendation.title: Refresh and accept the foundation
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, repeat focused exact-head Matrix live and Crabline validation, then land this PR before refreshing the dependent stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged lifecycle prerequisite and own the adjacent migration stack, making them the strongest available technical-routing candidate for this boundary decision.
